name: text-edit-schema
title: Text Edit Schema
description: TextEdit’s document schema as plain Tiptap extensions — every node, mark and attribute with its VegaStack Markdown rules, stable block ids (`blockId`) that Markdown never carries. No React, no DOM: the editor adds node views, a server builds the identical schema.

meta.whenToUse: Building a TextEdit document anywhere — a collaboration server, an import, an API — with exactly the editor’s nodes and attributes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Rendering a document to read — use MarkdownView.
